preconditions.description: The number of stations n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of two-way railways m is between 1 and 300,000 inclusive.
The number of incidents q is between 0 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= w_i <= 10**9 for w_i in w)
preconditions.description: Each construction cost w_i is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v and 1 <= d <= 10**9 for u, v, d in railways)
preconditions.description: Each railway connects two different stations u and v with a length d between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= k_i <= n and 1 <= x_i <= 4 * 10**8 for k_i, x_i in incidents)
preconditions.description: Each incident increases the cost of building a railway from station k_i by x_i, where k_i is between 1 and n inclusive and x_i is between 1 and 4 * 10^8 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of results is q + 1, corresponding to the minimal cost after each incident.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result is an integer representing the minimal cost of railway construction.
